lines.text: Red name at my counter. Cash only, sweetheart, and quick.
Cantor. Your tab's open. You lot crash hardest and tip best.
Pink for the shakes, blue for the jack-in, nothing for the crash. The crash is the price.
Choir buys more than Sable does. Don't tell Reyes; he'd raise the rent.

barks.text: Three in a day and you're mine for a week. Business model, sweetheart.
Vesper's end of the street charges for the truth. I charge for the morning after.
Nobody's ever come back to complain about the pink. Think about that.
